item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00256","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C12","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a material policy-drafting template: both letters address federally supported irrigation or reclamation works, focus specifically on repayment of federal construction costs, and caution that action on one project should not establish an undesirable general policy or precedent.
